verdict.rationale: A government e-services portal could plausibly ship a built-in AI or virtual assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only self-service transactions: registering accounts, filing returns, making payments and reporting changes. It never mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one, and the probes found no llms.txt, no OpenAPI spec and a 403 on the transactional portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
